responsibility: This header contains the core target description macros for the C6X port: ISA feature bits and TARGET_INSNS_* tests, predefined preprocessor symbols, storage layout and alignment rules, register numbering and allocation properties, ABI- and exception-related macros, assembler syntax and section-selection helpers, small-data placement policy, and other target constants consulted throughout GCC. It is the compile-time specification layer that connects generic GCC backend infrastructure to the C6X architecture and to the implementations in c6x.cc.
same_name_distinction: Provides the compile-time target specification for C6X through macros, constants, register/layout definitions, preprocessor builtins, and assembler/ABI hooks that other GCC code includes. Unlike `c6x.cc` it does not implement the hook bodies, unlike `c6x.md` it is not the RTL pattern database for instruction selection/scheduling attributes, and unlike `c6x.opt` it does not define the user-facing option table.
